description:
EasyTdd.Generators is a .NET source generator that simplifies test code by generating two types of helpers: builders and FluentMocks.

			Builder generator creates strongly-typed builder classes for your domain types, supporting constructor parameters, property setters, and generic type arguments. Builders help construct objects in tests with minimal boilerplate.

			FluentMock generator wraps the Moq framework to generate fluent, strongly-typed Setup and Verify methods for each method and property of the target interface or class, making mocks easier to use and maintain.

			The generator works independently and does not require additional tools.
			It is also used by the EasyTdd Visual Studio extension and can work with templates and settings defined by the extension.
releaseNotes:
6.0.1
- Aligned with the Visual Studio extension patch that fixes settings and default-template migration when opening solutions configured for version 0.5.
- Retained Roslyn 4.3.1 compiler compatibility, unchanged generated APIs, settings version 6 and template compatibility version 6.0.

6.0.0
- Adopted three-part release versions, with settings version 6 and template compatibility version 6.0.
- Preserved generated Builder and FluentMock APIs; configuration migration is performed by the matching Visual Studio extension or MCP server.
- Lowered the Roslyn API dependency to 4.3.1 so generators load in compiler hosts running Roslyn 4.3.1 or newer, including Roslyn 4.13.0 build agents.
- Fixed missing BuilderForAttribute and FluentMockForAttribute errors caused by older compiler hosts rejecting the generator.

0.5.3.2
- Made Roslyn a private build-time dependency so compiler packages and their System.* dependencies do not flow into consumer projects or cause NU1605 package downgrades.
- Ensured the package includes its shared domain assembly when built outside a solution.

0.5.3
- Corrected FluentMock generation for inherited and hidden members, including properties declared with new and namespace-qualified method types.
- Corrected tuple type rendering in generated builder and FluentMock signatures.
- Updated Scriban to 7.5.0 to address dependency security advisories.

0.5.2
- Added default settings when .easyTdd is absent.
- Fixed builder and FluentMock generation for inherited members, hidden properties, and indexers.

0.5.0.4
- Excluded properties without public setters from builder generation.

0.5.0.3
- Prevented duplicate generation of overridden members in builders and tests.

0.5.0.1
- Maintained backward compatibility with version 0.4.0.5.

0.5.0.0
- Added the incremental FluentMock source generator.

0.4.0.5
- Fixed builder generation for same-named classes in different namespaces.

0.4.0.3
- Fixed template resolution when a template in the root .easyTdd directory shares a name with one in a subdirectory.

0.4.0.0
- Introduced the incremental builder source generator, with version numbering aligned to the EasyTdd Visual Studio extension.
